# Genuine Groth16 circuit fixtures

Generated with snarkjs 0.7.6 from the official upstream compiled R1CS and witness. A second witness was calculated with public input a=0, b=2. Both proofs were independently accepted by snarkjs before use in the QMOOSA tests.

The source directory is named plonk_circuit, but its R1CS/witness are proving-system-independent. These proofs and verification key were generated by the Groth16 setup/prover; no PLONK key or proof was reused.

This setup is for tests only and is not a production ceremony. Never deploy these fixture keys. See provenance.json for upstream blob IDs, artifact hashes, tool version, and source license attribution. The upstream snarkjs tools and circuit artifacts are GPL-3.0; source: https://github.com/iden3/snarkjs.
